changelog.name: Royalty v3.1.8
changelog.body:
## Royalty v3.1.8

- Fixes audit findings in search resolution, boot-aware nonce persistence, and unused authentication surface.
- Retains fail-open handling when Telegram hook targets cannot be validated.

Tested fast path: official Telegram 12.10.4 (`versionCode 70992`). Other official Telegram builds are accepted only when every required hook surface resolves and validates semantically; ambiguous or missing targets fail open.

Requires Android 8.1+ and a Modern Xposed API 101-capable framework.

Source release: https://github.com/cepeter/Royalty-Telegram-Chat-Hiding/releases/tag/v3.1.8
Source commit: `b4feffe256eb4b7dd11f41eaddc4bbf4e2cda45b`
APK SHA-256: `d4ecbec5c38920002988e8f05e7417fd26fb34d9db0a206098b096d82d999aa9`

changelog.name: Royalty v3.1.11
changelog.body:
## Royalty 3.1.11

- Fixes Contacts hook installation on the affected official Telegram Play Store build.
- Skips abstract, static, synthetic, and bridge section-position declarations while retaining executable concrete overrides.
- Prevents abstract `xl0.O(int,int)` from rolling back the complete Contacts hook set.

Source release: https://github.com/cepeter/Royalty-Telegram-Chat-Hiding/releases/tag/v3.1.11

changelog.name: Royalty v3.1.10
changelog.body:
## Royalty 3.1.10

- Fixes static Activity, fragment, queued-handler, and staged catalog retention after lifecycle completion.
- Keeps dashboard tabs and the locked-settings gate below Android system bars while scrolling.
- Fixes false semantic-method ambiguity on official Telegram Play Store variants, restoring Search, Share, and Contacts hooks when concrete aliases are shadowed by superclass methods.

Source release: https://github.com/cepeter/Royalty-Telegram-Chat-Hiding/releases/tag/v3.1.10

changelog.name: Royalty v3.1.9
changelog.body:
## Royalty 3.1.9

- Adds a bounded, privacy-safe diagnostic event log and Status-screen text export.
- Shows a green bullet for each healthy diagnostic surface and a red bullet for each non-working state while retaining textual labels.
- Excludes chat titles, dialog IDs, account IDs, message contents, raw exception text, and framework/Telegram logcat from the diagnostic report.

Source release: https://github.com/cepeter/Royalty-Telegram-Chat-Hiding/releases/tag/v3.1.9

Tested fast path: official Telegram 12.10.4 (`versionCode 70992`). Other official Telegram builds are accepted only when every required hook surface resolves and validates semantically; ambiguous or missing targets fail open.

changelog.name: Royalty v3.1.6
changelog.body:
Royalty v3.1.6 adds DexKit-backed semantic hook resolution with versioned descriptor caching while preserving Modern Xposed API 101 protective interception and per-surface rollback.

Telegram 12.10.4 (versionCode 70992) remains the tested fast-path profile. Other official Telegram builds are accepted only when every required hook surface validates semantically; ambiguous or missing targets fail open.

Hook status now distinguishes Telegram not running from actual hook failures and preserves last-verified healthy state neutrally while Telegram is inactive.

Requires Android 8.1+ and a Modern Xposed API 101-capable framework.

changelog.name: Royalty v3.1.5
changelog.body:
Telegram header reveal/conceal is now immediate and no longer invokes device authentication. Device screen lock protects opening Royalty settings only.

The Royalty dashboard is reorganized into Chats, Privacy, Status, and Backup tabs.

Requires official Telegram 12.10.4 (versionCode 70992) and Modern Xposed API 101.

changelog.name: Royalty v3.1.4
changelog.body:
Fixes reveal health degradation caused by optional adapter redraw failures and introduces the redesigned Royalty settings dashboard.

Requires official Telegram 12.10.4 (versionCode 70992) and Modern Xposed API 101.

changelog.name: Royalty v3.1.3
changelog.body:
Fixes Telegram 12.10.4 search, share, and contact hook installation by decoupling concealment hooks from optional adapter-refresh resolution.

Requires official Telegram 12.10.4 (versionCode 70992) and Modern Xposed API 101.

changelog.name: Royalty v3.1.0
changelog.body:
## Royalty 3.1.0

### Highlights

- Adds stable account-owner bindings, account filters, migration review, and actionable diagnostics.
- Adds optional automatic re-concealment and Android device-credential protection.
- Adds AES-256-GCM encrypted configuration export/import with owner-aware preview.
- Adds a dismissible in-app update card.
- Makes catalog refresh, hooks, field writes, adapter reconciliation, and release publication more resilient.

Requires official Telegram `versionName 12.10.4`, `versionCode 70992`, package `org.telegram.messenger`.

Physical-device acceptance for the new 3.1.0 surfaces remains documented as pending. Repository, JVM, Android lint, signed release, reproducibility, signature, and APK-content gates passed.

readme:
# Royalty **Hide selected Telegram chats without changing or deleting them.** [![Latest release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/cepeter/Royalty-Telegram-Chat-Hiding?display_name=tag&style=flat-square)](https://github.com/cepeter/Royalty-Telegram-Chat-Hiding/releases/latest) ![Android 8.1+](https://img.shields.io/badge/Android-8.1%2B-3DDC84?style=flat-square&logo=android&logoColor=white) ![Telegram 12.10.4](https://img.shields.io/badge/Telegram-12.10.4-26A5E4?style=flat-square&logo=telegram&logoColor=white) [![GPL-3.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-GPL--3.0-blue?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/cepeter/Royalty-Telegram-Chat-Hiding/blob/main/LICENSE) An Xposed module for the official Telegram Android app. [Download](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/io.github.cepeter.royalty/releases/latest) · [Changelog](https://github.com/cepeter/Royalty-Telegram-Chat-Hiding/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) · [Security](https://github.com/cepeter/Royalty-Telegram-Chat-Hiding/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
Royalty started as a personal replacement for [Loyalty](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/ru.mike.loyalty) after it stopped working on my setup. It keeps chosen chats out of Telegram’s dialog lists, search results, share targets, and people pickers, with optional notification suppression. > [!IMPORTANT] > Royalty's tested profile is official Telegram **12.10.4** (`versionCode 70992`, package `org.telegram.messenger`). Other builds are accepted only when Royalty's semantic resolver validates every required hook surface; ambiguous or missing targets fail open. ## What it does - Hides selected chats from the main dialog list and folders. - Removes them from local/global search, recent results, messages, forums, and public-post results. - Removes them from share targets, contact pickers, new-group, add-member, and invite flows. - Can suppress new-message notifications for hidden chats. - Lets you reveal hidden chats temporarily with a three-second press and hold. - Keeps selections tied to stable Telegram account owners, with account labels, filters, and review of legacy selections. - Offers optional re-concealment on background, screen-off, or a 30-second, one-minute, or five-minute timeout. - Offers optional device screen-lock confirmation for settings and reveal. - Provides hidden-only filtering, selected counts, scoped selection, Undo, Save, and Discard. - Exports and imports encrypted, owner-aware configuration backups through Android's document picker. - Shows per-surface hook health in the app, so failures are visible instead of silent. - Checks GitHub Releases at most once every 24 hours when the app opens and shows a dismissible card when an update is available. Royalty does not delete chats, modify messages, or change Telegram’s stored dialog list. ## Before you install | Requirement | Supported version | |---|---| | Android | 8.1 or newer | | Hook framework | Vector/LSPosed with Modern Xposed API 101 support | | Telegram | Official app; 12.10.4 / 70992 is the tested profile; other builds require successful semantic validation | | Telegram package | `org.telegram.messenger` | > [!WARNING] > Version 2.1.0 uses the new package name `io.github.cepeter.royalty`. It installs separately from older builds using `io.github.cepeter.telegramhider`, and saved selections cannot migrate automatically. Disable and uninstall the old package first to avoid loading two copies of the hook. ## Install 1. Download the latest APK from [LSPosed/Xposed Modules Releases](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/io.github.cepeter.royalty/releases/latest). 2. Install the APK, then enable **Royalty** in Vector or LSPosed. 3. Scope the module to `org.telegram.messenger`. 4. Restart your device so the hook framework can activate Royalty inside Telegram. 5. Open Telegram and leave it running for a few seconds. 6. Open Royalty, tap **Refresh**, choose the chats to hide, and tap **Save**. Notification suppression is optional and stays off until you enable it. ## Accounts, privacy, and recovery Royalty 3.1.0 binds each saved hidden chat to the stable owner ID of its Telegram account. After upgrading an older configuration, legacy selections remain visible for review but do not conceal chats until you explicitly bind them to the displayed account owner and Save. Refresh the catalog with Telegram running, confirm each account label, and review any unavailable selection before changing accounts. A missing or incomplete refresh does not mean an account was logged out. If an account is replaced in the same slot, its predecessor's selections remain recoverable and do not transfer automatically. Use the account filter, search, or hidden-only view to narrow the list. **Select matching** acts on the visible scope. Undo reverses draft edits; Discard restores the last saved configuration. Save commits the draft only after account ownership is checked again. The diagnostics panel shows the installed and supported Telegram versions, cache age, bridge status, and per-surface health. A fresh check asks Telegram for current observations; it does not perform the [physical-device acceptance matrix](https://github.com/cepeter/Royalty-Telegram-Chat-Hiding/blob/main/docs/device-acceptance-3.1.0.md). Background re-concealment, screen-off re-concealment, reveal timeout, and device-lock authentication start disabled. Timeout choices are Off, 30 seconds, 1 minute, and 5 minutes. These options govern reveal state; notification suppression is independent. Authentication uses the device's configured screen lock and requires a secure lock to enable. Settings relock after backgrounding, while unsaved draft edits remain available after unlocking. ### Encrypted backups Tap **Export saved configuration**, enter and confirm a passphrase of at least 12 characters, and choose a document destination. Export reads the **confirmed saved configuration**, so save desired draft edits first. Saved legacy selections without a stable owner are **omitted**; the export prompt and completion count them. Bind those selections to the correct account owner and Save before relying on the backup for migration or reinstall. The backup contains owner IDs, signed dialog IDs, and notification, Local Premium, background, screen-off, and timeout preferences. It excludes chat titles and messages, catalog data, device credentials, authentication enablement, and temporary reveal state. Encryption happens in Royalty before the selected document provider receives bytes. A provider you choose may synchronize the **encrypted file** to a cloud account; keep the passphrase separately. To restore, tap **Import encrypted backup**, choose the file, and enter its passphrase. Review recognized and skipped owners, new and conflicting selections, and preference changes. Apply edits only the current draft; tap **Save** to persist or **Discard** to cancel. Royalty matches stable owners to current account slots and checks them again at Apply and Save. Unknown or ambiguous owners, conflicting saved bindings, and legacy unbound selections are not silently reassigned. Import preserves existing selections and the current authentication policy. If account ownership changes during the preview, reopen the file and review the new mapping. An interrupted document picker or activity recreation may require restarting the operation. ## Everyday use Configuration changes are synchronized through the framework's Modern Xposed remote-preferences service. Use the search field to filter the chat picker by title or dialog ID. Switch Telegram folders or restart Telegram if the visible list has not redrawn yet. To reveal hidden chats temporarily: 1. Open Telegram’s main chat list. 2. Press and hold the top ActionBar for three seconds. 3. Release when the reveal message appears. Repeat the gesture to conceal them again. Reveal mode resets when Telegram restarts and does not turn notification suppression off. ## Support matrix | Telegram surface | Status | |---|:---:| | Main dialog list | ✅ Supported | | Chat folders | ✅ Supported | | New-message notifications | ✅ Supported | | Search and global search | ✅ Telegram 12.10.4 | | Share and contact pickers | ✅ Telegram 12.10.4 | | New group, add member, and contact invite | ✅ Telegram 12.10.4 | Historical 2.2.0 repository and APK checks are recorded in [`docs/device-acceptance-2.2.0.md`](https://github.com/cepeter/Royalty-Telegram-Chat-Hiding/blob/main/docs/device-acceptance-2.2.0.md). The current 3.1.0 [device acceptance checklist](https://github.com/cepeter/Royalty-Telegram-Chat-Hiding/blob/main/docs/device-acceptance-3.1.0.md) remains pending physical execution; JVM and CI gates alone do not establish live Telegram behavior. ## If something is not working 1. Confirm that Royalty is enabled and scoped only to `org.telegram.messenger`. 2. Prefer the tested **versionName 12.10.4 / versionCode 70992** profile. On another build, check that every required hook surface reports healthy semantic resolution. 3. Restart the device after enabling or updating the module. 4. Open Telegram before tapping **Refresh** in Royalty. 5. Check the hook-status cards for `missing` or `runtime_error`. Hook failures fail open: Telegram keeps showing its normal, unfiltered content instead of crashing or hiding the wrong chats.
Safety and privacy details - Vector or LSPosed supplies the ART hook engine; Royalty does not patch ART structures itself. - Dialog and notification hooks return filtered copies rather than mutating their inputs. - Search surfaces remap visible adapter positions while preserving aligned names and metadata. - Share, group, and contact adapters require private-field replacement because Telegram 12.10.4 exposes no return-value hook at those boundaries. Royalty assigns filtered list copies; it never mutates those list instances. - Share dialog maps are filtered in place through Telegram's verified map API so Telegram-owned references keep their identity. - Configuration uses Modern Xposed remote preferences; it never requests world-readable app files. - Catalog requests require a signature-level permission and return through an exact-component `PendingIntent`. - Every request uses an active 128-bit nonce. - Catalog responses contain only the account, dialog ID, and display title, capped at 1,024 entries per account and 256 UTF-16 code units per title. - When Royalty opens, it sends at most one unauthenticated HTTPS request to the official GitHub Releases API every 24 hours. It sends no chat data or device identifier and never downloads or installs an APK automatically. See [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/cepeter/Royalty-Telegram-Chat-Hiding/blob/main/SECURITY.md) for the threat model and reporting process.
Build from source You need JDK 17 and Android SDK 36. ```bash ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug ``` Release builds use the four `TCH_*` signing variables configured in GitHub Actions. The tag workflow builds the APK twice, compares deterministic payload entries, verifies the RSA-PSS signature and Xposed metadata, and publishes checksum manifests. Dependencies are checksum-pinned in `gradle/verification-metadata.xml`. Modern Xposed API 101 is compile-only and is not bundled in the APK; its API-101 service client is packaged for framework-backed remote preferences. ### Project layout ```text app/src/main/java/.../core/ Filtering, validation, backup codec and import logic app/src/main/java/.../xposed/ Vector/LSPosed hooks and request bridge app/src/main/java/.../catalog/ Nonce-validated callback transport and private storage app/src/main/java/.../config/ Safe preference writer app/src/main/java/.../update/ Bounded GitHub release check and metadata validation app/src/test/ JVM contract tests ```
## Compatibility notes The fast-path runtime aliases are checked directly against the official Telegram **12.10.4** APK (`versionCode 70992`, SHA-256 `146ec03c20ce4c73ccfa12399f143c0db5992a3419d30ec0f17ef547b3eaba8d`). When those aliases do not validate, Royalty can use DexKit semantic fingerprints and structural checks, cache the validated descriptors per Telegram/module version, and fail open on ambiguous results. Telegram source commit [`9552e554`](https://github.com/DrKLO/Telegram/commit/9552e5541e1274b9557c9832b204dbfcaf44b3dc) is used only as a readable reference. Check Royalty’s hook-status panel after every Telegram update. ## License Royalty is licensed under [GPL-3.0](https://github.com/cepeter/Royalty-Telegram-Chat-Hiding/blob/main/LICENSE). Third-party notices are listed in [NOTICE.md](https://github.com/cepeter/Royalty-Telegram-Chat-Hiding/blob/main/NOTICE.md).
readmeZh: # 版税 **隐藏选定的 Telegram 聊天而不更改或删除它们。** [![最新版本](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/cepeter/Royalty-Telegram-Chat-Hiding?display_name=tag&style=flat-square)](https://github.com/cepeter/Royalty-Telegram-Chat-Hiding/releases/latest) ![Android 8.1+](https://img.shields.io/badge/Android-8.1%2B-3DDC84?style=flat-square&logo=android&logoColor=white) ![Telegram 12.10.4](https://img.shields.io/badge/Telegram-12.10.4-26A5E4?style=flat-square&logo=telegram&logoColor=white) [![GPL-3.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-GPL--3.0-blue?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/cepeter/Royalty-Telegram-Chat-Hiding/blob/main/LICENSE) 官方 Telegram Android 应用程序的 Xposed 模块。 [下载](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/io.github.cepeter.royalty/releases/latest) · [变更日志](https://github.com/cepeter/Royalty-Telegram-Chat-Hiding/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) · [安全](https://github.com/cepeter/Royalty-Telegram-Chat-Hiding/blob/main/SECURITY.md) 在它停止对我的设置起作用后，Royalty 开始作为 [Loyalty](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/ru.mike.loyalty) 的个人替代品。它将选定的聊天排除在 Telegram 的对话列表、搜索结果、共享目标和人员选择器之外，并具有可选的通知抑制功能。 > [!重要] >Royalty 的测试配置文件是官方 Telegram **12.10.4**（`versionCode 70992`，包 `org.telegram.messenger`）。仅当Royalty 的语义解析器验证每个所需的钩子表面时，才会接受其他构建；不明确或缺失的目标无法打开。 ## 它的作用 - 隐藏主对话框列表和文件夹中选定的聊天。 - 将它们从本地/全局搜索、最近结果、消息、论坛和公共帖子结果中删除。 - 将它们从共享目标、联系人选择器、新组、添加成员和邀请流程中删除。 - 可以抑制隐藏聊天的新消息通知。 - 按住三秒即可暂时显示隐藏的聊天记录。 - 通过帐户标签、过滤器和旧选择的审查，将选择与稳定的 Telegram 帐户所有者联系起来。 - 提供可选的背景重新隐藏、屏幕关闭或 30 秒、一分钟或五分钟超时。 - 提供可选的设备屏幕锁定确认设置和显示。 - 提供仅隐藏过滤、选定计数、范围选择、撤消、保存和丢弃。 - 通过 Android 的文档选择器导出和导入加密的、所有者感知的配置备份。 - 在应用程序中显示每个表面钩子的运行状况，因此故障是可见的而不是无声的。 - 当应用程序打开时，最多每 24 小时检查一次 GitHub 版本，并在有可用更新时显示可关闭的卡片。 Royale 不会删除聊天、修改消息或更改 Telegram 存储的对话列表。 ## 安装 1. 从 [LSPosed/Xposed Modules Releases](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/io.github.cepeter.royalty/releases/latest) 下载最新的 APK。 2. 安装 APK，然后在 Vector 或 LSPod 中启用 **Royalty**。 3. 将模块范围限定为“org.telegram.messenger”。 4. 重新启动您的设备，以便钩子框架可以激活 Telegram 中的Royalty。 5. 打开 Telegram 并让它运行几秒钟。 6. 打开Royalty，点击**刷新**，选择要隐藏的聊天，然后点击**保存**。 通知抑制on 是可选的，并且在您启用它之前保持关闭状态。 ## 帐户、隐私和恢复 Royale 3.1.0 将每个保存的隐藏聊天与其 Telegram 帐户的稳定所有者 ID 绑定。升级旧配置后，旧选择仍然可见以供查看，但不会隐藏聊天，直到您将它们明确绑定到显示的帐户所有者并保存。在运行 Telegram 的情况下刷新目录，确认每个帐户标签，并在更改帐户之前检查任何不可用的选择。刷新缺失或不完整并不意味着帐户已注销。如果同一位置的帐户被替换，则其前任帐户的选择仍然可恢复并且不会自动转移。 使用帐户过滤器、搜索或仅隐藏视图来缩小列表范围。 **选择匹配**作用于可见范围。撤消可撤销草稿编辑；放弃恢复上次保存的配置。仅在再次检查帐户所有权后，“保存”才会提交草稿。诊断面板显示已安装和支持的 Telegram 版本、缓存年龄、网桥状态和每个表面的运行状况。一项新的检查要求 Telegram 提供当前的观察结果；它不执行[物理设备接受矩阵](https://github.com/cepeter/Royalty-Telegram-Chat-Hiding/blob/main/docs/device-acceptance-3.1.0.md)。 后台重新隐藏、熄屏重新隐藏、显示超时、设备锁定认证启动禁用。超时选项有关闭、30 秒、1 分钟和 5 分钟。这些选项控制显示状态；通知抑制是独立的。身份验证使用设备配置的屏幕锁定，并且需要安全锁定才能启用。设置在后台重新锁定，而未保存的草稿编辑在解锁后仍然可用。 ### 加密备份 点击 **导出保存的配置**，输入并确认至少 12 个字符的密码，然后选择文档目标位置。导出会读取**已确认的已保存配置**，因此请先保存所需的草稿编辑。 **忽略没有稳定所有者的已保存旧选择**；导出提示和完成对它们进行计数。将这些选择绑定到正确的帐户所有者并保存，然后再依靠备份进行迁移或重新安装。备份包含所有者 ID、签名对话 ID 以及通知、Local Premium、背景、屏幕关闭和超时首选项。它不包括聊天标题和消息、目录数据、设备凭据、身份验证启用和临时显示状态。在选定的文档提供者接收字节之前，Royalty 中会进行加密。您选择的提供商可能会将**加密文件**同步到云帐户；单独保存密码。 要恢复，请点击 **导入加密备份**，选择文件，然后输入其密码。查看已识别和跳过的所有者、新的和冲突的选择以及偏好更改。应用仅编辑当前草稿；点击“**保存**”以保留，或点击“**放弃**”以取消。版税将稳定所有者与经常账户位置进行匹配，并在“应用”和“保存”中再次检查它们。未知或不明确的所有者、冲突的已保存绑定以及遗留的未绑定选择不会以静默方式重新分配。导入会保留现有选择和当前身份验证策略。如果帐户所有权在预览期间发生更改，请重新打开文件并查看新映射。中断的文档选取器或活动重新创建可能需要重新启动操作。 ## 日常使用 配置更改通过框架的 Modern Xposed 远程首选项服务进行同步。使用搜索字段按标题或对话框 ID 过滤聊天选择器。如果可见列表尚未重绘，请切换 Telegram 文件夹或重新启动 Telegram。 要暂时显示隐藏的聊天： 1. 打开 Telegram 的主聊天列表。 2. 按住顶部的 ActionBar 三秒钟。 3. 当出现显示消息时松开。 重复该手势以再次隐藏它们。当 Telegram 重新启动时，显示模式会重置，并且不会关闭通知抑制。 ## 如果有些东西不起作用 1. 确认版税已启用且范围仅限于“org.telegram.messenger”。 2. 首选经过测试的 **versionName 12.10.4 / versionCode 70992** 配置文件。在另一个版本中，检查每个所需的钩子表面是否报告健康的语义解析。 3. 启用或更新模块后重新启动设备。 4. 打开 Telegram，然后点击 Royale 中的 **刷新**。 5. 检查钩子状态卡是否有“missing”或“runtime_error”。 挂钩失败无法打开：Telegram 继续显示其正常的、未经过滤的内容，而不是崩溃或隐藏错误的聊天。 <详情> 安全和隐私详细信息 - Vector 或 LSPoded 提供 ART hook 引擎； Royale 不会修补 ART 结构本身。 - 对话框和通知挂钩返回过滤后的副本，而不是改变其输入。 - 搜索表面重新映射可见适配器位置，同时保留对齐的名称和元数据。 - 共享、群组和联系人适配器需要私有字段替换，因为 Telegram 12.10.4 在这些边界处没有公开返回值挂钩。版税分配过滤列表副本；它永远不会改变那些列表实例。 - 共享对话地图通过 Telegram 的经过验证的地图 API 进行过滤，因此 Telegram 拥有的引用可以保留其身份。 - 配置使用现代 Xpose 远程首选项；它从不请求世界可读的应用程序文件。 - 目录请求需要签名级权限，并通过精确组件“PendingIntent”返回。 - 每个请求都使用一个活动的 128 位随机数。 - 目录响应仅包含帐户、对话框 ID 和显示标题，每个帐户的上限为 1,024 个条目，每个标题的上限为 256 个 UTF-16 代码单元。 - 当Royalty打开时，它每24小时最多向官方GitHub Releases API发送一个未经身份验证的HTTPS请求。它不会发送聊天数据或设备标识符，也不会自动下载或安装 APK。 有关威胁模型和报告流程，请参阅 [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/cepeter/Royalty-Telegram-Chat-Hiding/blob/main/SECURITY.md)。 <详情> 从源代码构建 您需要 JDK 17 和 Android SDK 36。 ````bash ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug ```` 发布版本使用 GitHub Actions 中配置的四个“TCH_*”签名变量。标签工作流程构建 APK 两次，比较确定性有效负载条目，验证 RSA-PSS 签名和 Xposed 元数据，并发布校验和清单。 依赖项在“gradle/verification-metadata.xml”中固定校验和。现代 Xpose API 101 仅供编译，未捆绑在 APK 中；其 API-101 服务客户端针对框架支持的远程首选项进行了打包。 ### 项目布局 ````文本 app/src/main/java/.../core/ 过滤、验证、备份编解码器和导入逻辑 app/src/main/java/.../xposed/ Vector/LSPosed 钩子和请求桥 app/src/main/java/.../catalog/ Nonce 验证的回调传输和私有存储 app/src/main/java/.../config/ 安全首选项编写器 app/src/main/java/.../update/ 有界的 GitHub 版本检查和元数据验证 app/src/test/ JVM 合约测试 ```` ## 兼容性说明快速路径运行时别名直接根据官方 Telegram **12.10.4** APK（`versionCode 70992`、SHA-256 `146ec03c20ce4c73ccfa12399f143c0db5992a3419d30ec0f17ef547b3eaba8d`）进行检查。当这些别名未验证时，Royalty 可以使用 DexKit 语义指纹和结构检查，缓存每个 Telegram/模块版本的已验证描述符，并在结果不明确时失败打开。 Telegram 源提交 [`9552e554`](https://github.com/DrKLO/Telegram/commit/9552e5541e1274b9557c9832b204dbfcaf44b3dc) 仅用作可读参考。每次 Telegram 更新后检查Royalty 的挂机状态面板。 ##
